novella.title: Hic Non Sunt Dracones
novella.tagline: A standalone historical adventure set in 1897, at the end of the great age of exploration.
description: In the decadent halls of the St. James Society, clerks now replace explorers, and discovery is measured in profit. But Major Jason Havelock, a veteran of debatable exploits and absolute conviction, refuses to believe the world has surrendered all its mysteries.

When he uncovers a forgotten map hinting at a lost city deep in the Brazilian wilderness, a reluctant young clerk joins an expedition bound for the heart of the War of Canudos, where failed military campaigns, ambushes, disease, and the sertão itself have already consumed thousands.
Hic Non Sunt Dracones is a complete standalone novella — part homage to the great adventure stories of the past, part farewell to them, and a first taste of the kind of fiction I write.
